lines: I  L O V E  C R E AT I N G  L I T T L E
T H I N G S  T H AT  B R I N G
It can be a vase filled with herbs or
flowers from the garden, a candle and
photo placed lovingly on a side table, a
cluster of rocks and crystals placed in a
special place. A handwritten note that has
me smile in delight when I read it.
The aim is to dot things around your
house, car and office that bring you
pleasure. That when you see them your
body responds and is filled with joy.
It could be putting on a red lipstick,
wearing a certain perfume, or engulfing
your shoulders in a luxurious cashmere
wrap. A funky hat, getting out a brand
new pencil and writing pad, a special
cup to drink your coffee or favourite hot
By constantly creating all these little
bundles of joy, the mind is creating a
new way of thinking and being!
Pair that together with gratitude and
brags and you are well on your way to
C R E A T I N G
B U N D L E S
